Sett's E only applies a brief slow if it grabs enemies on just one side. If Sett grabs you with R, Flash and Cleanse cannot remove the suppression. Items that remove crowd control, such as Mercurial Scimitar, can remove Sett's R suppression. Sett's R damage scales with the grabbed target's bonus health. While Sett has R available, stack with your allies to leave no room to be thrown. Rumble has no escape and Sett has multiple pieces of CC. One catch chains into the rest, so spacing comes first.

**Build**
Rumble deals mostly magic damage and Sett has low magic resist, so it lands hard as is.

**How to fight**
For a basic trade, fire both E shots, then use Q. Landing the second E on an enemy slowed by the first greatly amplifies the slow and magic resistance reduction. If you cannot dodge all of W, move sideways to avoid the center line's true damage. Most of Rumble's damage relies on his empowered Q in the Danger Zone.
